c: An incident is assigned to a group that has an on-call shift, and nobody in the group is the assignee.
say: An incident is assigned to a group that has an on-call shift, and nobody in that group is the assignee yet.

c: The group's trigger rule starts an on-call subflow in the background. On pdi2 there are no trigger rules yet, so nothing starts.
say: The group's trigger rule starts an on-call subflow in the background. On pdi2 there are no trigger rules yet, so today nothing starts.

c: With Assign By Acknowledgement, the people on call are contacted in turn, by email, SMS or a call, as their preferences say.
say: With assign by acknowledgement, the people on call are contacted in turn, by email, text message or a call, as their preferences say.

c: Reply ACC by email or SMS, or press 1 on a call. You become the assignee and the work notes say … acknowledged.
say: To take it, reply A C C by email or text, or press one on a call. You become the assignee, and the work notes say you acknowledged it.

c: Reply REJ, press 2, or don't answer in time: the next person is contacted, then the next level.
say: Reply R E J, press two, or don't answer in time, and the next person is contacted, then the next level.

c: If nobody accepts, the shift's catch-all is told: one named person, everyone on the roster, or the group's manager.
say: If nobody accepts, the shift's catch-all is told last: one named person, everyone on the roster, or the group's manager.
